title: Devin Desktop adapter (formerly Windsurf)
description: Compact managed block (about 2.5 KB) in ~/.codeium/windsurf/memories/global_rules.md that fits the 6,000-character global cap and points to ~/.agents for the full rules. Skills come from ~/.agents/skills.
postInstall: Devin Desktop: global_rules.md is limited to 6,000 characters in total; the managed block uses about 2,500, so keep your own text in that file under about 3,400 characters. The block is a compact form of ~/.agents/CORE.md and tells the agent to read the full file before substantive work. Skills are read from ~/.agents/skills. No subagents or hooks are installed; see components/devin/HOOKS.md.
